description: This plot illustrates the relationship between Average Lagging (AL) and BLEU scores for four different evaluation settings. The x-axis is labeled "Average Lagging (AL)", features a linear scale, and displays numeric tick marks from 2 to 8 with a regularly spaced interval of 2. The y-axis is labeled "BLEU", operates on a linear scale, and displays numeric tick marks from 20 to 32 with a tick interval of 2, accompanied by corresponding horizontal dashed grid lines. The line for "Consistency-CE" is represented by a light purple dashed line with circular markers; it shows a steady upward trend, starting at an x-value of approximately 0.9 with a y-value of roughly 19.2, and rising consistently to end at an x-value of about 8.5 with a y-value near 31.3. The "Inconsistency-CE" data series is depicted as a dark purple dashed line with square markers, which follows an increasing trajectory, beginning at roughly x=1.5 and y=22.8, and climbing to a final point near x=8.4 and y=31.5. The "Inconsistency-CE-MP" series is shown as a blue dashed line with square markers, demonstrating an upward trend that commences at an x-value of approximately 2.2 and a y-value of 22.4, and finishes near an x-value of 8.5 with a y-value of 31.7. Finally, the "Consistency-Bi" series is illustrated with a solid red line and star markers; it exhibits a steady increase across the plotted range, originating at approximately x=1.6 and y=25.8, and rising to a final recorded value near x=8.4 and y=32.3.
